I'm older than most of you, but not so well off that home ownership back in the U.S. is any more a realistic option for me than it is for you.

However, I have spent time living in Mexico, the Philippines and Thailand, and can truthfully tell you that there are a whole lot of options awaiting you, provided you are willing to make the effort to adapt. Internet is available for real throughout most of the world, and most countries won't care if you're making a buck online if it means you're kicking it back to them for rent and food.

In each of the countries I mentioned above living on US$500@month is realistic and even comfortable, provided you're not going out to bars and restaurants all the time and are willing to use the public transport. Will probably need to put in some time finding a suitable place though. Works out to under $20@day... what is that, a couple of hours on odesk/elance/whatever?

You're only a lost generation back at home. The Internet means you have possibilities your parents never had; most people my age (50's) didn't have the opportunity to just pack up and head to a place like Thailand, for instance. No ATM machines, no cellphones, no Internet, means no way to make a living for most back then. But today it's a piece of cake.

I'm not saying the situation doesn't suck that this is what you're almost forced to consider just to make ends meet, but at the same, it's also a pretty amazing opportunity should you choose to look at it that way.
To what extent have you explored moving to another country?
I'm coming to the end of 7 years abroad. I did 3 in Kazakhstan and 4 in the uae. Don't regret a minute of it. Travel and saving opportunities easily made homesickness worth it.
are you thinking that you would be trying to get residence in these places or just continually renewing your visa?

You could do either.

Mexico for instance can be done 180 days at a time before needing to do visa run. Residency there is easy, but only if you have (last I checked) $120K lying around in savings somewhere. But lots of people do the visa run.

The Philippines will let you stay up to three years before making you do the visa run. Of course there you need to get on a plane to do that. And it's a bit pricey, ~$50@month. But you make that up easily in rent, food, etc.

Thailand is the trickier one. You need to be over 50 to qualify for their long-stay visa, but you get 30 days for free on arrival and a lot of people do visa runs to stay. They change the rules a lot though, and they are trying to discourage the stay-by-doing-visa-runs-all-of-the-time stuff. So if it looks dire, there's always...

Cambodia! Never been myself, and it's easily the poorest of the countries listed, but I follow the forums on it and you can live there, very affordably, and have a pretty good time as well. Get the business visa on arrival, pay like $360 (I think) to extend it for a year, and renew each year without having to ever do visa runs. If I were young again and starting out Cambodia would definitely be my first stop. They've got Internet (maybe need to be a little patient), and Thailand is maybe $40US away for when medical care or shopping comes to mind.

Friend or Foe? Dog meat trade divides China

This is a more complex issue than it seems from an outsider's perspective.

Historically, dogs in China were for guarding things, not companionship.

Then, very recently, like past 10~20 years recently, as the middle class emerged people began owning dogs for pleasure. Prior to that it was seen as a ridiculous extravagance to willfully keep around another mouth to feed. There are still plenty of senior citizens who hold this view. Considering how many people starved during their lifetimes, it's not that surprising they feel that way.

So the "dog as friend" or "dog as people" concepts are a relatively new introduction, whereas only 30 years ago people would eat any kind of meat they could catch and kill.

So, mother-in-law knows daughter loves loves dogs. Last year she tells daughter she's selling Good Boy for meat unless she gets 200 from daughter. A month later turns out Good Boy was supposedly 'stolen'. Last month same with 'Lady' (an awesome dog we love). Daughter pays off mom not to sell dog to be slaughtered. Low and behold Lady is gone this weekend. Sold to be bludgeoned to death and eaten. Daughter fuckinnng devastated again.

So this is how it goes now. Explained to mother-in-law that we usually give her money each month however since she sold OUR DOG that WE BOUGHT FROM HER last month she now owes us money. She will not get any more monthly payments and if we see another cat or dog is sold or missing that's another month she gets nothing. She is told she WILL GET MONEY every month the same dog is in the same yard when daughter arrives.

Of course there is other issues like people buying dogs meant and bred for extremely cold northern climates and then me seeing them trotted around on hot 40 celsius streets this morning and not a single Chinese I've met has a fucking clue that maybe the dog needs to drink some water. So basically a lot of dogs here suffer shitty lives and might be better off put out of their misery anyways.

But yeah, thing is dogs were bred to be emotional, loyal and believe they are part of the family. Which makes it the problem with selling Lady Dog who protects daughter and is emotionally bonded with daughter (as opposed to chicken or duck).

Now, of course the biggest problem is that to convince a Chinese guy not to eat dog meat just made him 1000X now prouder to eat the dog meat and loudly chewing and with a big sneer on his face. Because in this culture that dog meat became more delicious and he became a much bigger tougher cool alpha man. So... you get a dilemma. Try to discourage it makes them really hot and puffy and arrogant to do is more. (not unlike telling a Chinese man the animal is endangered. He takes that as a compliment you are admitting he's a badass big man king and only wants to eat the very last surviving one to attain some godhead status).

late night, rambling. very very upset about Lady Dog getting sold and butchered by the very fucking people she loyaly protected for the last 6 months like a champion.
